title: Scenario 4: Traffic Amplification & Missing Timeouts
description: Exposed API endpoint introduces full table scan and synchronous un-timeouted external call.

repo_meta.name: reporting-api
repo_meta.description: Customer analytics and metrics aggregation service

changed_files.patch:
@@ -55,3 +55,14 @@ router = APIRouter()
+@router.get("/api/v1/customer-summary")
+def get_customer_summary(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
+    # Unbounded query without pagination
+    customers = db.query(Customer).all()
+    # Synchronous outbound call with no timeout
+    enrichment = requests.get("https://api.crm-partner.io/v1/profiles")
+    return {
+        "count": len(customers),
+        "data": [c.to_dict() for c in customers],
+        "crm": enrichment.json()
+    }
